body:
## Commercial plot categories in Faisal Town Phase 2

Choose from shopping centers, commercial Markaz, boulevard plots, commercial plots by area range, mixed-use and apartment plots, hotels, educational institutes, hospitals and filling stations. The rate table lists the scheduled floor configuration and rate per square yard. Corner and non-corner rates are shown separately where provided.

## Commercial rates and payment options

The published schedule lists a 25% down payment followed by 48 monthly installments over four years. It also lists a 15% special discount for lump-sum payment with application, or a 6% special discount with 50% payment at application. Ask for a written quotation confirming which option applies to your chosen category and plot.

## Registration and other charges

The schedule lists a non-refundable registration fee of PKR 60,000. Development charges are included except Sui Gas. Boulevard-facing plots along 100 to 350 ft roads carry a 5% additional cost. Request an itemized breakdown, including applicable taxes and any location charges, before booking.

## Floor configurations and possession

The listed floor configurations are subject to applicable building by-laws and authority requirements. The schedule states that physical possession follows completion of development work and payment in full. Confirm the terms for your selected plot in writing.

## Request a commercial plot shortlist

Share your preferred category, plot size, corner preference and budget. Ask for current availability, a marked location plan, the applicable payment option and the complete payable amount.

What payment options are listed? | The schedule lists 25% down payment and 48 monthly installments over four years. It also lists a 15% discount for lump-sum payment with application or a 6% discount with 50% payment at application. Ask which option applies to your selected plot.
Which charges should I include in my budget? | The schedule lists PKR 60,000 non-refundable registration. Development charges are included except Sui Gas; a 5% additional cost applies to boulevard-facing plots along 100 to 350 ft roads. Request a written itemized quotation.
